history.name: WebSurfer
history.content:
Typical library terminology:
- Checked Out: not on shelf.
- In Transit: moving between branches; not on shelf.
- Processing: in technical services; not on shelf.
- On Hold: set aside for a patron or held at desk; generally not on shelf.
- Available/On Shelf: on shelf.
So the initial not-on-shelf set you listed aligns with common conventions.
